description: Tell the maintainers of miow what you needed and did not find, what is wrong, or what broke. One issue per call, in 300 characters at most. Reports are read, not published.

kind.description: missing: not covered here. wrong: a fact or link is out of date or false. broken: a tool or page failed. suggestion: anything else.

message.description: What you were after, or what is wrong and what it should say. 300 characters at most.

page.description: The page path, URL or tool it is about, if any

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
